Updated `src/solution.py` to:
- Allow Friday starts after 15:00.
- Accept weekday abbreviations without requiring an ISO date.
- Allow any positive integer duration, keeping start times on 15-minute boundaries.
- Prevent out-of-hours events from producing invalid suggestions.

Preserved lunch exclusion, working hours, and event buffers. All checks passed, including 500 randomized cases.
